text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: serving-runtime cluster prod-eu p99 latency spike detected for route /v1/stream (SLO breach). Auto-page sent to oncall. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3123456789

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty triggered to SRE rotation: maria is oncall. Incident priority: P1.

maria: I’m on it. Seeing p95 ~600ms, p99 ~2.8s for streaming tokens. Customers report stalls.

kevin: Any signs of degraded GPU or infra? I’m checking node-level metrics.

maria: GPU utilization normal. Noticed a sudden uptick in KV cache evictions and prefill failures on the kv-shard-7/8 pool. Eviction rate jumped ~x8 at 07:12 UTC.

chris: That matches the paging: I see fragmentation on the in-memory kv segments. Per-shard free space down to 3%.

liz: Quick customer impact check: 5 tenants hit SLO alerts, highest impact on tenant: acme-inc, streaming session stalls ~10-20s.

ashley: Confirmed. Route /v1/stream uses prefill-heavy path, which seems to be amplifying decode latency when cache misses occur.

kevin: Running a quick query on cache metrics: `redis-cli -h kv-prod-7 INFO memory` — memory fragmentation_ratio: 1.42, evicted_keys: 12450 (1h).

maria: Logs show a lot of prefill timeouts and then decode falling back to disk-based kv reads. Snippet:``` 
[07:12:03] prefill: shard=kv-7 key=ctx:abcd status=MISS
[07:12:03] decode: shard=kv-7 key=ctx:abcd read_ms=1200
[07:12:04] stream: stall token_idx=42 wait_ms=980
```

chris: Looks like prefill vs decode imbalance: prefill autoretry is overwhelming decode IO path when eviction causes fragmentation, causing tail latency spikes.

maria: Immediate mitigation: reduce prefill concurrency and increase decode IO priority. Proposing: 1) throttle prefill concurrency on shard 7/8, 2) bump decode worker threads from 8->12 temporarily, 3) enable fallback routing to kv-standby cluster for heavy tenants. Thoughts?

kevin: Agree. Also push a hotfix to increase cache_threshold to avoid agressive eviction for next 30m. I can roll config to shard 7/8 only.

ashley: Can we flip prefill off for /v1/stream for impacted tenants only as quick mitigation? That should reduce pressure.

maria: Yes. I’ll patch routing: set header X-Redwood-Prefill: off for tenants acme-inc and beta-co. Will push in 2m.

chris: I’ll run `kubectl scale deployment kv-decoder -n prod --replicas=4` -> up from 2 to 4 to handle decode backlog.

kevin: Pushing cache config change now (shard-targeted): `curl -XPOST https://config.prod/configs/kv-shard-7 -d '{"cache_threshold":0.85,"eviction_policy":"lru_lazy"}'` — applying.

maria: Rolling patch to drop prefill concurrency: `/ops/deploys/prefill-throttle` — deployed to shard 7/8. Monitoring.

incident-bot: Update: maintenance action started at 07:18 UTC. Postmortem channel created: #postmortems/3123456789.

liz: Customer-facing comms: I'll draft a short message to acme-inc and notify CS about mitigation steps. No SLA credit decision yet, collecting metrics.

kevin: After actions: p95 down to ~220ms, p99 holding at ~1.1s — still above SLO but improving. Eviction rate dropping.

maria: Streaming stalls reduced, backpressure cleared on most streams. Some tail errors still for long-seq sessions (>8k tokens).

chris: Observed cache compaction starting on kv-7 after config change. fragmentation_ratio trending from 1.42 -> 1.12.

maria: Good. Next steps: 1) keep prefill throttle for 1h, 2) schedule background compaction for kv shards, 3) add alert to detect prefill:decode ratio > 3 for future.

ashley: Handoff: maria you’re keeping hot-seat until 08:00 UTC? Then kevin takes over.

maria: Correct. I’ll update the incident record in the tracker and tag owners.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria. Estimated mitigation in progress.

maria: Adding quick runbook note for this class: if p99 spike + eviction rate x5, do targeted prefill throttle, increase decode workers, and bump cache threshold. Will add to ops wiki.

liz: Customer note drafted and sent to acme-inc, cc’ing support. They replied: "thanks, noticing improved response times".

kevin: Will keep monitoring. If p99 persists after compaction, we should consider proactive shard rebalancing.

maria: Closing the page for now but keeping incident open for postmortem. If anyone sees regression ping here or directly to oncall. :thumbsup:
